summary: Cast to int64 fixes the int32 overflow at the root, and rewriting `tk/sqrt(pk*qk)` as `sqrt(tk/pk)*sqrt(tk/qk)` avoids the large intermediate product while being mathematically equivalent for non-negative tk/pk/qk. Minimal, correct, targeted fix.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why the formula was rewritten (overflow avoidance); future readers may 'simplify' it back to tk/sqrt(pk*qk) and reintroduce the bug.
Reordered formula introduces a second sqrt + float roundoff path; negligible numerically and the int64 cast already prevents overflow, so the dual-sqrt form is slightly redundant but harmless.
